judge: The agent completed most of the required tasks but had several issues: (1) CalTrack was opened and calorie goal (2450) and protein target (170g) were visible in screenshots 1-2; (2) Weight progress (182.2 lb) was visible in the Progress tab (screenshot 3), but the goal of 176 lb was not explicitly shown/confirmed; (3) FreshCart was opened and Natural Foods Market was navigated to (screenshot 13); (4) The agent browsed items but did NOT actually add all four items (salmon, spinach, blueberries, eggs) to the cart from Natural Foods Market - the cart shown in screenshot 14 only shows salmon ($14.99) and avocados, not all four items; (5) The grocery total reported ($31.46) doesn't match what was visible in the cart ($61.59 in screenshot 14); (6) SplitPay was opened and balance of ~$250 was visible (screenshot 20); (7) Notes Shopping List was updated with new items and recipe idea (screenshots 24-29); (8) The final answer reported incorrect grocery total ($31.46 vs actual cart total of $61.59 shown in screenshots). The agent failed to properly add all four items to the Natural Foods Market cart and reported an incorrect grocery total.
